channel.title: Lawn, Garden & Landscaping | YardCompute
channel.description: Grass seed, sod, mulch, topsoil, gravel and river rock calculators.

item.title: How Much Grass Seed Do I Need? (Chart + Free Calculator)
item.description: Find out how many pounds of grass seed your lawn needs. This chart shows seed amounts for 5,000 sq ft and 1 acre at common label rates, and the free calculator works it out for your exact lawn size and seed bag.

item.title: How Much Gravel Do I Need? Cubic Yards and Tons Chart
item.description: Gravel chart for common areas at 3 inches deep, in cubic yards and tons. Great for planning paths, patios and gravel beds. Use the free gravel calculator to enter your own size, depth and supplier density.
